info.cls_ename: SFSU-FCU 2+2 Bachelor’s Program in Computer Science

description.describe_ch: The purpose of this course is to make the students, via the practical training, to learn the skills of programming and have the ability of programming. The course mainly includes (1) the ability to define at an appropriately high level of abstraction the data structures and algorithms that needed, (2) the ability to devise alternative implementations of data structures, (3) the ability to employ different data structures in algorithm design, and (4) the ability to analyse the time complexity of data structures' operation.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1) 課堂禮儀：準時到課、積極參與、有效溝通、記筆記、實踐操作
2) 網路禮儀：技術準備、積極參與、尊重多樣性、課堂秩序
3) 學生責任：學術誠信、準備、尊重行為、回饋、出席、參與、開放溝通
根據特定課堂的動態和目標，調整這些準則，無論是在實體課堂還是虛擬網絡空間，都將有助於營造尊重、高效和合作的學習環境。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1) Classroom etiquette: punctuality, active participation, communication, note-taking, hands-on
2) Network etiquette: technical preparedness, engage actively, respect diversity, classroom decorum
3) Student responsibility: academic integrity, preparation, respectful behavior, feedback, attendance, engagement, open communication

Customizing these guidelines to align with the specific class dynamics and objectives will help foster a respectful, productive, and collaborative learning environment, whether it's in a physical classroom or a virtual network space.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 學生應該在每週作業及期末報告中產生自己的原創作品，準確地代表他人的作品，並對來源給予適當的引用。這種對學術誠信的承諾在教育社群中培養了信任、尊重和負責任的環境。 在整個課程中，學生被期望在學習評估、課堂互動和課程的整體表現中展示出高度的個人責任、倫理和專業精神。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
The academic integrity encompasses the principle that students should produce their own original work, accurately represent the work of others, and give proper credit to sources. This commitment to academic integrity fosters an environment of trust, respect, and accountability within the educational community.
Throughout the course, students are expected to demonstrate a high level of personal responsibility, ethics, and professionalism in their learning assessments, interactions in class, and performance throughout the computer vision course.
